name: Aloo Gobi
subtitle: dry-cooked potato and cauliflower, browned at the edges and heavy on ginger

image.alt: Aloo gobi, potato and cauliflower with tomato and coriander

ingredients.qty: 1 medium (700g), cut into small florets with a little stalk on each
3 medium (400g), peeled and cut into 2cm cubes
2 inch, half grated and half julienned
ingredients.note: aloo gobi wants more ginger than you think

ingredients.qty: 4 tbsp, heated to smoking and cooled

prepNotes: Cut the florets small and dry them thoroughly on a cloth after washing. Wet cauliflower steams and goes limp instead of browning.
Keep the potato cubes the same size as the florets so they finish together.
Have a lid ready — the vegetables cook covered on low, in their own steam, with no added water.

steps.text: Heat 3 tbsp of the oil in a wide kadhai until it shimmers and crackle the cumin seeds for 20 seconds.
Fry the potato cubes on medium-high for 6 minutes, undisturbed for the first 3, until they are gold on several faces, then lift them out.
steps.tip: Moving them too early tears the crust off. Let them sit.

steps.text: Add the cauliflower to the same pan with the remaining oil and fry 6 minutes until browned in patches.
steps.tip: Brown patches on the florets are the flavour of this dish. Do not crowd the pan.

steps.text: Push the cauliflower aside, add the onion, and fry 5 minutes until soft and gold.
Stir in the grated ginger, garlic and green chillies and fry 90 seconds.
Add the turmeric, coriander powder and chilli powder, stir 20 seconds, then add the tomato and 1 tsp salt.
Cook 6 minutes until the tomato has broken down into a coating masala rather than a gravy.
Return the potatoes, stir to coat everything, cover and cook on the lowest heat for 10 minutes, shaking the pan every few minutes.
steps.tip: No water. The vegetables release enough of their own and water turns this into a mush.

steps.text: Check that a knife slides into both potato and stalk with no resistance; give it 5 minutes more if not.
Uncover, stir in the amchur and garam masala, and cook 2 minutes to dry it off.
Finish with the julienned ginger and coriander and serve with roti.

storage: Keeps 3 days refrigerated. Reheat in a dry pan on medium so it crisps again rather than steaming. Does not freeze — the cauliflower collapses.
